invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object on successful completion; null is not a valid result.
The write statuses within the HoodieWriteMetadata should be non-null by contract, reflecting the underlying insert operation's result.
A successful bulk insert should return at least one WriteStatus object representing the status of write actions performed.
All WriteStatus objects within the metadata list are expected to be non-null, indicating each operation's status is recorded.
